events.name: Bash
events.head: Check publish holds, mirror commit, and probe settings
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -i "hold\|82686f6" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -12 | cut -c1-260; echo ---; tail -5 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300; echo ---; git ls-remote https://github.com/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live.git HEAD 2>&1 | head -2; echo ---; grep -n "wiring-probe\|BASE\|PREFIX\|PEND" app/scripts/probe-live-wiring.mjs | head -20; git status --short app/scripts/probe-live-wiring.mjs; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py --help 2>&1 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the live wiring probe against the mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; date -u +%FT%TZ > /tmp/t102-start; node scripts/probe-live-wiring.mjs > /tmp/t102-probe.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; date -u +%FT%TZ > /tmp/t102-end; cat /tmp/t102-start /tmp/t102-end; grep -c '^PASS' /tmp/t102-probe.txt; grep -c '^FAIL' /tmp/t102-probe.txt; grep -c '^PEND' /tmp/t102-probe.txt; cut -c1-230 /tmp/t102-probe.txt; git ls-remote https://github.com/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live.git HEAD

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the failed asset is really broken or a transient error
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/brand/logos/tools/x-white.svg?v=$RANDOM"; done; ls -la app/public/brand/logos/tools/x-white.svg 2>&1 | cut -c1-120; gh api repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/commits?per_page=3 --jq '.[] | .sha[0:7]+" "+.commit.committer.date+" "+(.commit.message|split("\n")[0])' 2>&1 | cut -c1-200; gh api repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/pages/builds/latest --jq '.status+" "+.commit[0:7]+" "+.updated_at' 2>&1 | head -3; tail -3 /User

events.name: Bash
events.head: Re-run the wiring probe on the settled mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; git ls-remote https://github.com/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live.git HEAD | cut -c1-7; date -u +%FT%TZ > /tmp/t102-start2; node scripts/probe-live-wiring.mjs > /tmp/t102-probe2.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; date -u +%FT%TZ > /tmp/t102-end2; cat /tmp/t102-start2 /tmp/t102-end2; grep -c '^PASS' /tmp/t102-probe2.txt; grep -c '^FAIL' /tmp/t102-probe2.txt; grep -c '^PEND' /tmp/t102-probe2.txt; grep -v '^PASS' /tmp/t102-probe2.txt; grep 'checkout →' /tmp/t102-probe2.txt | cut -c1-120; git ls-remote https://github.com/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live.git HEAD | cut
